page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 2 vCPUs. The system is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance type does not include any local storage, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. It does not feature any GPU accelerators, and there are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with the instance.

The processor configuration lacks support for advanced vector and matrix extensions such as AVX, AVX512, and AMX, as well as hardware-accelerated cryptography flags like AES and SHA_NI. Given the balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this server is positioned for general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, and lightweight application hosting that do not rely on specialized instruction sets or local storage.
